facts.fact: Law 2023-012 of 19 July 2023, promulgated and published in Journal officiel no. 55 bis, amends Law 2017-007 of 22 June 2017 on electronic transactions, redefining its terms and adding rules on electronic seals, digital safes, 20-year retention of electronic copies and signatures, and a penalty for usurping the status of trust service provider.
